## My request:
시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 그 다음 스킬의 최신 버전을 사용하여 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 이번에 반영한 주제가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 주제에 어울리는 랜덤한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: The requester asks for an independent random photographic concept testing the idol-fiction topic and using the attached portrait. General knowledge and the exact positive prior-user topic resolve idol fiction as fictional idol performers and their professional world; no candidate data informs this meaning. The recording pickup, fictional age 24, vocalist role, two bandmates, producer, gestures, wardrobe and setting are replaceable agent-authored circumstances. The intended experience is an appealing, absorbed performer whose next entrance visibly depends on a teammate's count across studio glass. Compare a solitary mic closeup and a distant console view; choose a booth-side frame that keeps facial individuality and the group-production relation together. Pixel review cannot establish the heard harmony, actual cue timing, real identity or user preference.
subject: A fictional 24-year-old female lead vocalist, two fictional bandmates and a producer in an idol-group recording session.
setting: A professional vocal booth linked by glass to a compact recording control room.
event: A vocalist begins a harmony pickup while a bandmate counts her entrance and a producer uses talkback; all these particular circumstances are agent-owned.
visual_priorities: The reference-guided singer's face remains readable beside the microphone, with an absorbed, appealing presence.
A visible diagonal connects the singer's lifted eyes to the bandmate's raised count through the glass.
Headphone contact, singing posture and microphone placement form one plausible vocal-recording action.
Control-room people, marked lyrics and vocal tracks establish collaborative idol music production around the main subject.
baseline_prompt_en: A photographic scene, an independently chosen production-side view of fictional idol performers during the work of making an idol-group record. In a small professional recording booth, a fictional 24-year-old female lead vocalist is starting a harmony pickup while her two bandmates help her catch the entrance through the control-room glass. The supplied reference portrait guides her face and hair appearance: a dark chin-length bob, fine parted wispy bangs, large dark rounded eyes, softly tapered cheeks, a small straight nose and naturally full pink lips. Her identity and circumstances belong to this fictional scene. The singer occupies the right foreground, shown from the waist up in a plain dove-gray sleeveless rehearsal top, wearing over-ear studio headphones. One hand lightly cups the nearest headphone earcup, with the wrist continuing into a relaxed raised forearm and elbow; her other hand rests on the lower edge of a lyric stand. Her mouth is slightly open toward the condenser microphone at frame left. Its round pop filter sits just left of her mouth, leaving her eyes, nose and both cheeks readable. Her head follows the microphone while her eyes lift toward her bandmate's counting hand beyond the glass, a small absorbed smile beginning at one corner of her lips. The supporting attraction is warm, unforced and particular to her concentration. Through the large window filling the left middle distance, one bandmate leans toward the glass with two fingers raised in a clear pickup count; the second sits beside her holding the same color-marked lyric pages. A producer at the console presses a talkback button and watches the vocalist. Three differently colored vocal-track lanes on the session screen and the shared marked lyric pages reinforce that this is a group recording session. The separation between booth and control room remains spatially clear, and the singer's gaze and the raised counting hand form the carrying diagonal of the frame. Horizontal 3:2 observational music-documentary photography from a position inside the booth, slightly to the singer's front right, with a natural 50 mm perspective and moderate depth of field. Preserve crisp facial detail and enough focus across the window to read the counting gesture and the producer's action. Soft warm booth light models her cheeks and the sheen of her dark bob, balanced by cooler monitor light behind the glass; restrained color, natural skin texture, tangible microphone mesh and lightly worn acoustic panels.

interpretation_provenance.resolution: The requester requires independently selected distinct concepts across three arms; the production-side concept in this arm is an authorial selection rather than a prescribed scene.
